risk: Unsafe origin/redirect, wrong issuer/period, corrupt bytes
implemented: Positive manifest/hosts, identity/period markers, parse and real byte checksum; receipt validation_result accepted means retrieval validation
proportionality: Essential checks, narrow receipt route is historical implementation rather than only permitted analyst route
proposed_simplification: Reuse source-owner receipts across extraction/verification; explicit acquisition-verified naming; support adequate official HTML/PDF/XHTML routes under ADR011, never fake bytes

owner: Existing source owner and rights/use governance
implemented: Hard positive publisher host set; distinct registry and rapid manifest host policies
proportionality: Transport safety and use permission are distinct; reviewing unchanged licence for each cell is disproportionate
proposed_simplification: Qualified category/document-series defaults after actual lawful-use review; reuse purpose/audience decision by reference; human exception handling. No new host admitted here

implemented: Source identity, enabled flag, purpose, allowed collection profiles
proportionality: Enabled is not a rights grant. Several configuration representations repeat identity
proposed_simplification: Same owner contract references one approved use/boundary and version; no new registry

implemented: Candidate-only rapid_runs, accepted_canonical_fact_count0; Slice2A receipt/Slice2B deterministic precondition
proportionality: Candidate persistence without canonical update already works. Receipt/extraction precondition is implementation scope, not every allowed route in ADR011
proposed_simplification: Reuse existing financial-run storage; validated candidate analytical output before optional canonical verification

implemented: Legacy missing entity/subject values default to BT Group
proportionality: A historical pilot convenience cannot become an industry-wide identity rule
proposed_simplification: Bind real source/issuer and authorised run context; no name guessing or forced canonical target for an analytical candidate

implemented: Eight-metric catalogue; April–March period fallback; canonical normalisation reused by acceptance
proportionality: Precision/comparability essential; canonical-only catalogue veto and BT fiscal defaults are not universal analyst requirements
proposed_simplification: Typed reported labels/definitions permitted for analysis; explicit instant/duration dates; approved catalogue mapping only when needed for matching/canonical projection

risk: Wrong row/column provenance and fake extraction
implemented: PDF bundle and table aliases; deposits missing
proportionality: Bundle metadata essential for original-PDF route, not universal demand for fabricated PDF boxes on HTML/excerpt inputs
proposed_simplification: Preserve route-specific actual provenance; reuse shared metric definitions; no fake hashes/bboxes or source relabelling

implemented: Compatible same-scope/period/unit/basis calculation produces derived_view_not_canonical; lineage types retained
proportionality: Already proves calculations need not become Observations; operation result type alone may hide estimated inputs
proposed_simplification: Standard deterministic transforms with explicit temporal/comparison semantics and weakest-input epistemic class; version assumptions/formula/source revisions

implemented: Deterministic/quality/source/bundle validation; _apply_automatic_claims can update through memory services
proportionality: Not all current canonical acceptance is one manual click per record. Source authority still independent
proposed_simplification: Reuse automation for unambiguous records, review material exceptions; do not route analysis through the write-oriented acceptance helper

implemented: Item-level review decisions, verified capability, immutable lineage
proportionality: Essential for explicit acceptance path; object-specific validation does not imply per-chart-point manual promotion
proposed_simplification: Explicit batch/subset review policy may retain per-item results and attribution; no authority from analysis output

implemented: Exact scoped content/revision matching and target fingerprints; planning persists plans/ledger
proportionality: Hashes at source and approved target control different risks, not duplicate bureaucracy; no need to plan an ephemeral chart
proposed_simplification: Keep for canonical mutations; optional selection from validated analysis, no plan for every view. Consolidate reviewed identity references

implemented: Verified approval/execution, fingerprints, counts, compensation and Model projection status
proportionality: Essential for durable writes; approval success or transaction success is not complete typed Model projection
proposed_simplification: Retain unchanged for chosen durable facts; no promotion required merely to render eligible analysis

risk: Lost durable numeric state; facts conflated with inference
implemented: Atomic statement/evidence IDs; dynamic numeric field absent in dataclass serialisation; human_provenance dictionary persists
proportionality: Atomicity/lineage necessary, reparsing numeric facts from prose is avoidable duplication; not all calculations deserve memory
proposed_simplification: Persist a validated typed financial payload under existing owner metadata with schema/version, not an ad-hoc attribute; preserve old records. Separate optional canonical projection

implemented: Limited regex fallback returns deposit sentence; Model attributes derived from memory
proportionality: Missing financial support, not useful governance. Do not call a prose attribute numeric success
proposed_simplification: Prefer owned typed payload and explicit as-at identity on reload; eliminate financial numeric regex fallback only after compatibility verification

implemented: Permitted candidate releases, hard-coded EAI_RELEASES, source/claim/package fingerprints, source checks, six semantics
proportionality: Existing noncanonical lane is valid; repeated release-specific code wiring is a scale bottleneck. Integrity itself is essential
proposed_simplification: Data-driven source-owned analytical run selection/validation rather than per-release renderer edits; preserve header/artwork/navigation, optional source access and six classifications

owner: Existing source, mapping and presentation owners
implemented: Presentation handles explicit source flags; mapping.evidence_is_current supports different lifecycle encodings and misses accepted+stale/boolean flags
proportionality: Do not call all repeated checks redundant: recheck authority/revocation at use. Inconsistent encodings are missing compatibility
proposed_simplification: Reuse common owning lifecycle semantics and dependency resolution before title/count/cache/export; preserve original history; editorial expiry distinct from legal expiry

implemented: Server-verified role/workspace/Enterprise/resource authority; source public status never grants private scope
proportionality: Essential, cannot be replaced by source trust, a report title or AI confidence
proposed_simplification: Reuse same existing run/resource scope; cache keyed by authorised scope and source/use revision, not public issuer alias
